purpose: Test whether adding a bounded RTLCoder generator capability to the confirmed OpenWorker/Qwen3.5 RTL persona is operationally useful on the existing deterministic popcount canary, without changing controller authority or oracle.

workload.task: Create solution.v containing a synthesizable SystemVerilog module named popcount4 with input logic [3:0] bits and output logic [2:0] count. count must equal the number of set bits in bits for all 16 input values. Use the tools to write the solution and verify it.
workload.oracle: iverilog compile plus exhaustive 16-vector testbench; PASS marker required

adaptive_gate.phase_1: Download and hash-verify RTLCoder, then run one standalone specialist generation against the fixed oracle.
adaptive_gate.on_phase_1_fail: Preserve negative evidence and stop before downloading Qwen3.5.
adaptive_gate.on_phase_1_pass: Install pinned OpenWorker, pull exact planned Qwen3.5 identity, and run one specialist-augmented persona repetition on the same runner.

scientific_conditions.specialist_smoke: generated RTL passes the independent oracle
scientific_conditions.integrated_support: augmented persona invokes generate_verilog at least once and final RTL passes the independent oracle
scientific_conditions.efficiency: report wall time, writes, tests and tool calls against the confirmed baseline; do not collapse them into a composite score
